description: Analyze infidelity indicators from 5th, 8th, and 12th house patterns, plus protective factors. Requires premium plan.

person_a_date.description: Person A's date of birth in YYYY-MM-DD format

person_a_latitude.description: Person A's birth place latitude (e.g. 19.076 for Mumbai)

person_a_location.description: Person A's birth place name (e.g. 'Mumbai, India')

person_a_longitude.description: Person A's birth place longitude (e.g. 72.877 for Mumbai)

person_a_time.description: Person A's time of birth in HH:MM format (24h, defaults to 12:00)

person_a_timezone.description: Person A's timezone name (e.g. 'Asia/Kolkata', defaults to UTC)

person_b_date.description: Person B's date of birth in YYYY-MM-DD format (omit for single-person analysis)

person_b_latitude.description: Person B's birth place latitude (e.g. 19.076 for Mumbai)

person_b_location.description: Person B's birth place name (e.g. 'Mumbai, India')

person_b_longitude.description: Person B's birth place longitude (e.g. 72.877 for Mumbai)

person_b_time.description: Person B's time of birth in HH:MM format (24h, defaults to 12:00)

person_b_timezone.description: Person B's timezone name (e.g. 'Asia/Kolkata', defaults to UTC)

name: get_infidelity_risk
